description:
The groomer's `propose` step runs itself every morning, early enough for the 06:30 PT briefing, and moves nothing. This is the schedule DRE-3586 asked for, absorbed into DRE-4677 with the time moved from 06:30 to about 06:15 PT: the run takes around eight minutes and its proposal must exist before the briefing is assembled. The CEO's signed answer on DRE-3586 (2026-09-21 14:04 PT) reopened decision D5 for exactly this — "a scheduled 06:30 PT run of propose only. It writes one proposal comment and moves nothing; the drain still needs my Approve. The rest of D5 stands." — and his second signed answer the same day (16:35 PT) named the standing card and the repo order: agent-bureau, bureau-pipeline, then portico.

`self-groomer.yml` today carries two on-demand triggers and no cron, and `tests/test_groomer_wiring.py` turns red if a `schedule:` appears, if the trigger set widens, or if any job is not a `uses:` of the reusable. All of that was written to protect D5 and all of it is rewritten here to protect the narrower rule that replaces it: the schedule reaches `propose` and never `drain`.

## What to build

`.github/workflows/self-groomer.yml` gains a third trigger and two jobs:

* `schedule:` with two cron lines, `15 13 * * *` and `15 14 * * *` (GitHub crons are UTC; on any day exactly one of them is 06:15 on the `America/Los_Angeles` clock, and the sibling gate script decides which).
* A `gate` job, `if: github.event_name == 'schedule'`, the ONE job in the file with its own steps: check out this repo (this repo is the pipeline, so the checkout is placed at `.bureau-pipeline` exactly as a product-repo stub would place it), then run the gate script built by DRE-4688 and declare its two outputs. No model call, no write.
* A `schedule` job, `needs: gate`, `if: needs.gate.outputs.go == 'true'`, calling the reusable with literals only: `pipeline_ref: main`, `mode: propose`, `judgement: "on"` (quoted), `capacity: "20"`, `priority: agent-bureau,bureau-pipeline,portico`, `card: ${{ vars.GROOM_PROPOSAL_CARD }}`, `intake_hold: ${{ vars.INTAKE_HOLD }}`, `secrets: inherit`. No `dry_run`, no `lane` (omitted so the reusable's defaults apply, the way the `drain` job already omits them).
* The existing `call` job (guarded `workflow_dispatch`) and `drain` job (guarded `repository_dispatch`) are untouched in substance; their `if:` guards already exclude the schedule event.
* The header comment is rewritten to record three decisions with their dates: D5 (DRE-2683, 2026-08-23), the drain amendment (DRE-3337, 2026-09-08), and the propose-only schedule (DRE-3586's signed answer, 2026-09-21, absorbed by DRE-4677). The sentence "ON DEMAND, NEVER ON A SCHEDULE" and "there is still no `schedule:`" are gone.

`.github/workflows/groomer.yml`: header comment only — the same three-decision record replaces the "ON DEMAND, NEVER ON A SCHEDULE" paragraph. No input or step changes.

`tests/test_groomer_wiring.py`: the on-demand tests become the schedule contract, asserted against the committed YAML:

* the trigger set is exactly `{workflow_dispatch, repository_dispatch, schedule}`, and `schedule` carries exactly the two cron strings above;
* the `gate` job exists, is guarded on `schedule`, runs `scripts/groom_schedule_gate.py` (the string `groom_schedule_gate.py` appears in one of its steps), and passes `${{ vars.GROOM_PROPOSAL_CARD }}`;
* the `schedule` job `needs` the gate, is keyed on `needs.gate.outputs.go == 'true'` and nothing else, and its `mode` is the literal `propose` with no `${{` in it — a schedule that could reach `drain` is the decision being reversed silently;
* `test_no_workflow_in_this_repo_schedules_the_groomer` is replaced by a test that walks EVERY scheduled workflow in the repo, every job (not only the first), and asserts the only job calling `groomer.yml` from a scheduled file is this stub's `schedule` job with `mode: propose`;
* `test_the_pen_switch_is_read_on_both_triggers` and `test_every_job_calls_the_reusable_at_the_qualified_ref` are narrowed to "every job that carries `uses:`" so the gate job (steps, no `uses:`) is not a violation, and both still cover `call`, `drain` and `schedule`;
* the `DecisionRecordTest` and the module docstring name the third decision (`DRE-3586`, `2026-09-21`, `DRE-4677`, `schedule`) alongside the two they name today.

`docs/groomer.md`, the cadence section: "On demand, never a schedule" becomes the three-trigger record — the hand dispatch, the Approve-fired drain, and the 06:15 PT gated propose — with the cost paragraph rewritten (the thing that "relied on remembering" no longer does). `DocumentationTest` is updated in the same commit so the doc and the test agree.

`scripts/groomer.py`: the module docstring's cadence paragraph ("The cadence is D5, approved 2026-08-23: on demand…") is corrected to the same record. Docstring only; no code in this file changes on this card.

**Files:** `.github/workflows/self-groomer.yml`, `.github/workflows/groomer.yml`, `tests/test_groomer_wiring.py`, `docs/groomer.md`, `scripts/groomer.py`

## Contract (shared with DRE-4688, the gate script)

* The gate step runs `python3 .bureau-pipeline/scripts/groom_schedule_gate.py --card "${{ vars.GROOM_PROPOSAL_CARD }}"` with `LINEAR_API_KEY` in its environment, and declares job outputs `go` and `why` from the script's `$GITHUB_OUTPUT` lines.
* The `schedule` job is keyed on `needs.gate.outputs.go == 'true'` and nothing else.
* The gate exits 1 only for "inside the 06:xx PT window and no open card to post to"; the off-hour cron of the pair exits 0 with `go=false` and the run stays green.

## Vendor boundary (standards/vendor-boundaries.md)

* Q1 — a `schedule` run initiates as `github-actions`; the reusable has no actor gate, and `secrets: inherit` on a schedule event hands it the repository's Actions secrets (this is not a fork or dependabot context).
* Q2 — `vars.GROOM_PROPOSAL_CARD` and `vars.INTAKE_HOLD` are repository variables, readable on every event including `schedule`.
* Q3 — GitHub may delay a cron by several minutes under load; 06:15 leaves the eight-minute run inside the 06:30 window with margin, and the gate's window is the whole 06:xx hour so a late cron still goes.
* Q5 — `groomer.yml` already carries `concurrency: {group: groomer, cancel-in-progress: false}`, so a scheduled propose overlapping a hand run queues rather than races; `post_proposal` is idempotent per batch id, so a retried morning posts nothing twice.

Not in this card: the gate script itself (DRE-4688), the standing card being open (DRE-4691 — until it is, the first in-window run goes red with a message naming the card and its state, which is the designed loud refusal), and any change to what the proposal contains.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `self-groomer.yml` carries `schedule:` with exactly `15 13 * * *` and `15 14 * * *`, a `gate` job guarded on `schedule` that runs `groom_schedule_gate.py` with `${{ vars.GROOM_PROPOSAL_CARD }}`, and a `schedule` job that `needs: gate`, is keyed on `needs.gate.outputs.go == 'true'`, and calls `groomer.yml@main` with `mode: propose` as a literal, `judgement: "on"`, `capacity: "20"`, `priority: agent-bureau,bureau-pipeline,portico`, `card: ${{ vars.GROOM_PROPOSAL_CARD }}`, `intake_hold: ${{ vars.INTAKE_HOLD }}`, `pipeline_ref: main`, `secrets: inherit` — pinned by tests against the committed YAML.
- [ ] A test walks every scheduled workflow in the repo and every job in it, and fails if any scheduled job other than this stub's `schedule` job calls `groomer.yml`, or if that job's `mode` is anything but the literal `propose`.
- [ ] The `call` and `drain` jobs still carry their event guards, `intake_hold: ${{ vars.INTAKE_HOLD }}`, `uses: …/groomer.yml@main`, `pipeline_ref: main` and `secrets: inherit`, pinned by the narrowed every-`uses:`-job tests.
- [ ] The headers of both workflow files, the wiring test's docstring, `docs/groomer.md`'s cadence section and `scripts/groomer.py`'s module docstring all record the three decisions with their dates (`DRE-2683` 2026-08-23, `DRE-3337` 2026-09-08, `DRE-3586` 2026-09-21 absorbed by `DRE-4677`), and none of them still says "never on a schedule" — pinned by `DecisionRecordTest` and `DocumentationTest`.
- [ ] `python3 -m pytest tests/test_groomer_wiring.py tests/test_self_host_stubs.py tests/test_intake_pen.py -q` is green, and the full suite has no new failures.
- [ ] Tests are committed before the implementation (`python3 scripts/check_tdd_commits.py origin/main HEAD` exits 0).

**Blocked by:** DRE-4688
